City-centre locators and documented relationships. Lines are not transport routes.
HAER AL-35, printed p1 / PDF p3
ACIPCO is distinct from USCIP&F in the 1913 map; this is not one company changing headquarters.
The source identifies southern investors; no per-investor capital totals or precise funding routes are asserted.
